content.text: Digital sellers in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other restricted countries struggle with payment platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-which-architecture-actually-3|Lemon Squeezy]] Squeezy, and Paddle, which either reject their applications or charge excessively high fees. This leaves them to navigate the complex world of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-which-architecture-actually-2|no-kyc]] payment gateways, where security and reliability are often compromised for the sake of convenience. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges a meager 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online|COREMERCH guide to difference]] retains a staggering $921, a significant advantage for any serious digital seller.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

In the absence of traditional payment gateways, digital sellers turn to alternative solutions like NOWPayments, which offers automatic webhook support, 300+ cryptocurrencies, and a 0.5% fee on all transactions. Another option is Google Pay, which provides a seamless payment experience but comes with strict regulations and high fees. Then there's Binance Pay, which boasts a massive user base but is notorious for its strict KYC requirements. Lastly, there's the lesser-known option, Cash App, which offers instant payments but is limited to specific regions and currencies. Each of these options has its pros and cons, but only a few are truly viable for digital sellers in restricted countries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

NOWPayments stands out for its ability to cater to restricted countries, with a no-KYC policy and a 0.5% fee on all transactions. Google Pay, on the other hand, is restrictive and only available in a few countries. Binance Pay is limited to specific regions and has strict KYC requirements, making it unsuitable for digital sellers in restricted countries. Cash App is also regional-specific and has its own set of limitations. In contrast, NOWPayments provides a more inclusive solution, making it the preferred choice for digital sellers in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, NOWPayments is unmatched, with transactions processed in real-time. Google Pay is slow and cumbersome, with long processing times. Binance Pay is also slow, and its fees are significantly higher than NOWPayments. Cash App is instant but limited to specific regions and currencies. In terms of fees, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%, while Google Pay charges exorbitant fees. Binance Pay is also expensive, and Cash App has its own set of fees. The real cost for digital sellers is the time and resources wasted on navigating these alternative solutions.
NOWPayments offers a no-KYC policy, making it the preferred choice for digital sellers in restricted countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

NOWPayments allows digital sellers to maintain ownership and control over their transactions, with automated delivery and payment processing. Google Pay, on the other hand, takes control of the payment process, and Binance Pay has strict regulations and high fees. Cash App is also restrictive, with limited automation and delivery options. In contrast, NOWPayments provides a seamless automation experience, making it the preferred choice for digital sellers who value ownership and control.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of payment architecture depends on the digital seller's specific needs and situation. If you're in a restricted country, NOWPayments is the clear winner, offering a no-KYC policy and a 0.5% fee on all transactions. If you're looking for a seamless payment experience, Google Pay might be a good option, but be prepared for strict regulations and high fees. If you're willing to navigate the complexities of alternative solutions, Binance Pay or Cash App might be viable options, but be aware of the limitations and fees associated with each.
Which payment gateway does not require KYC?

The most important question for digital sellers is: which payment architecture will give me the most control and flexibility? The answer is NOWPayments, which offers a no-KYC policy, automated delivery, and a 0.5% fee on all transactions. With NOWPayments, digital sellers can maintain ownership and control over their transactions, making it the preferred choice for those in restricted countries or seeking a seamless automation experience.
Google Pay and Binance Pay have strict regulations and high fees, making them unsuitable for digital sellers seeking a seamless automation experience.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, follow these steps: deploy a Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site, set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, connect to a Supabase or Google Sheets database, configure file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and integrate NOWPayments for automated on-chain payment verification.
